info.name: Vatstack API Specification Batches Rates API
Retrieves all VAT rate objects, including standard VAT rates and VAT rates for digital products.

params.name: country_code
params.description: Filter results by a 2-letter ISO country code.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 20.

params.name: member_state
params.description: Boolean to filter results by EU Member State.

items.docs: Retrieves all VAT rate objects, including standard VAT rates and VAT rates for digital products.

info.name: Retrieves a geolocated VAT rate by IP address.

params.name: ip_address
params.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to geolocate. If none is provided, the IP address of the request is used.

items.docs: Retrieves a geolocated VAT rate by IP address.
